description: This file declares functions and types for managing Git tags in the libgit2 library, including lookup, creation, deletion, listing, and peeling of tags.

methods.name: git_tag_lookup
methods.description: Lookup a tag object from the repository using its full ID.

methods.name: git_tag_lookup_prefix
methods.description: Lookup a tag object from the repository using a prefix of its ID.

methods.name: git_tag_free
methods.description: Free the memory associated with a loaded tag.

methods.name: git_tag_id
methods.description: Get the object ID of a tag.

methods.name: git_tag_owner
methods.description: Get the repository that contains the tag.

methods.name: git_tag_target
methods.description: Get the target object of a tag.

methods.name: git_tag_target_id
methods.description: Get the ID of the tagged object.

methods.name: git_tag_target_type
methods.description: Get the type of the tagged object.

methods.name: git_tag_name
methods.description: Get the name of the tag.

methods.name: git_tag_tagger
methods.description: Get the author (tagger) of the tag.

methods.name: git_tag_message
methods.description: Get the message associated with the tag.

methods.name: git_tag_create
methods.description: Create a new tag object in the repository.

methods.name: git_tag_annotation_create
methods.description: Create a new annotated tag.

methods.name: git_tag_create_frombuffer
methods.description: Create a tag from raw buffer data.

methods.name: git_tag_create_lightweight
methods.description: Create a lightweight tag pointing directly to an object.

methods.name: git_tag_delete
methods.description: Delete a tag reference from the repository.

methods.name: git_tag_list
methods.description: List all tags in the repository.

methods.name: git_tag_list_match
methods.description: List tags matching a pattern.

methods.name: git_tag_foreach
methods.description: Iterate over all tags, calling a callback.

methods.name: git_tag_peel
methods.description: Peel a tag to find the underlying object.
